release_notes: Keeps the legacy Production action hidden while the Factburst Autopilot shell is active.
Top-bar cleanup now identifies the header action group structurally instead of relying on one exact Production label string.
Production remains hidden even when another startup hook changes its icon or spacing after Autopilot loads.
The compact Autopilot navigation and Build 48 startup activation fix are unchanged.
No sidebar geometry changes are included; the left-edge clipping seen in the supplied screenshot was from the screenshot crop rather than the app layout.
